reimbursement.payment_note: FY2027 weights 9.9191 / 6.7023 / 5.9200; base payments $73,292 / $49,523 / $43,743. 426 fell 1.1021 weight vs FY2026 (custom-made interbody device cases moved out of its title).

reimbursement.description: Combined anterior and posterior cervical spinal fusion with MCC / without MCC
Multiple level spinal fusion except cervical with MCC / without MCC
Single level spinal fusion except cervical with MCC / without MCC
reimbursement.payment_note: FY2027 weights 5.2339 / 3.2596; base payments $38,673 / $24,085. FY2026 national unadjusted rates per Cerapedics guide: $38,782 / $23,507. This is the DRG pair most lumbar biologics cases land in.

reimbursement.description: Legacy 'Combined anterior/posterior spinal fusion' and 'Spinal fusion except cervical' DRGs
reimbursement.payment_note: Not present in the FY2027 Table 5 and not in the FY2027 deletion list. The FY2027 final rule text (CMS-1849-F, 91 FR, Aug 4 2026) states that the level-based MS-DRGs 426, 427, 428, 447 and 448 'had recently become effective October 1, 2024' (i.e. created in the FY2025 rule) and cites the FY2026 final rule (90 FR 36552) for continuing GROUPER-logic requests on them; it names MS-DRG 402 (Single Level Combined Anterior and Posterior Spinal Fusion Except Cervical), 426-428 (Multiple Level Combined A/P, 426 title also carries 'or Custom-Made Anatomically Designed Interbody Fusion Device'), 447-448 (Multiple Level Spinal Fusion Except Cervical; 447 also carries the custom-device title) and 450-451 (Single Level Spinal Fusion Except Cervical; 450 title also carries the custom-device clause). Any reimbursement guide still quoting 453-460 is at least two fiscal years stale.

reimbursement.description: Spinal fusion except cervical with spinal curvature, malignancy, or infection with MCC / CC / without (FY2026 title also included 'or extensive fusions')
reimbursement.payment_note: FY2027 weights 7.6211 / 5.3668 / 4.0371; base payments $56,312 / $39,655 / $29,830; weights fell 0.7823 / 0.5963 / 0.1355 because extensive fusions moved to new DRGs 523-525.

reimbursement.description: Extensive or complex spinal fusion procedures except cervical with MCC / CC / without CC/MCC
reimbursement.payment_note: New for FY2027 (effective Oct 1 2026): weights 13.7383 / 9.8322 / 7.2950; base payments $101,512 / $72,650 / $53,903. Final rule text: cases reporting an extensive spinal fusion are reassigned from MS-DRGs 426-428 and 456-458, and cases reporting a custom-made anatomically designed interbody fusion device or SI-joint fusion with an internal fixation device with tulip connector are reassigned from MS-DRGs 402, 426-428, 447-448, 450-451 and 456-458, to new 523-525 (Extensive or Complex Spinal Fusion Procedures Except Cervical with MCC / with CC / without CC/MCC). Created from SI-Bone (iFuse Bedrock Granite) and Carlsmed (aprevo) requests.

reimbursement.payment_note: Medicare NTAP effective Oct 1 2026 for Infuse in TLIF only: max $4,396.60 FY2027 (65% of cost above DRG payment); inpatient Medicare FFS only; ALIF/OLIF, dental and trauma not eligible. Hospital must report the X code plus the 0SG fusion code.

reimbursement.description: Introduction of recombinant bone morphogenetic protein into joints (U) or bones (V), open (0) or percutaneous (3); substance G other therapeutic substance, qualifier B recombinant BMP
reimbursement.payment_note: Pre-existing codes for rhBMP; CMS says 3E0U0GB remains correct for Infuse in ALIF/OLIF and 3E0V0GB for tibial fracture/other bone uses. Informational only: no payment impact outside NTAP.

reimbursement.code: 0SG/0RG fusion tables, character 6 device: 7 / A / J / K
reimbursement.description: Fusion of joints: device 7 = Autologous Tissue Substitute (autograft), A = Interbody Fusion Device, J = Synthetic Substitute (ceramic/synthetic bone graft), K = Nonautologous Tissue Substitute (allograft/DBM/cellular allograft). 'Z' no-device fusion codes were deleted in FY2019.
reimbursement.payment_note: Device value drives MDC 08 DRG assignment logic only; no separate payment for the graft material. Example codes in CMS DRG definitions: 0RG73J0, 0RG73K0, 0RG73A0, 0RG8070.

reimbursement.code: XW0V0P7 (gentamicin-eluting, CERAMENT G); XW0V0BC (vancomycin-eluting, CERAMENT V, new FY2027)
reimbursement.description: XW0V0P7: Introduction of gentamicin-eluting bone void filler into bones, open approach, new technology group 7 (title revised for FY2027 from 'antibiotic-eluting'; code created Oct 1, 2021 for CERAMENT G). XW0V0BC: Introduction of vancomycin-eluting bone void filler into bones, open approach, new technology group 12 (new FY2027, CERAMENT V, tied to an FY2027 NTAP application).
reimbursement.payment_note: FY2027 final rule (CMS-1849-F, Federal Register Aug 4 2026): XW0V0P7 redesignated from non-O.R. to 'non-O.R. affecting specified MS-DRGs', and cases reporting it reassigned from the lower severity levels (without CC/MCC or with CC) to the highest (with MCC) level in MS-DRGs 463, 474, 477, 480, 492, 616 and 628, plus new MS-DRG 403 (Hip or Knee Procedures with Principal Diagnosis of Periprosthetic Joint Infection with MCC or Insertion of Antibiotic-eluting Bone Void Filler) paired with 404 (without MCC); affected DRG titles gain 'or Insertion of Antibiotic-eluting Bone Void Filler'. XW0V0BC inherits the same O.R. status and MS-DRG assignments. CERAMENT G's infection NTAP ran Oct 1 2022 to Sep 30 2025; an open-fracture NTAP was approved for FY2026. Effective Oct 1, 2026.

reimbursement.description: Allograft, morselized, or placement of osteopromotive material, for spine surgery only (add-on)
reimbursement.payment_note: MPFS work RVU 0.00 (bundled); OPPS status indicator N (packaged, no separate APC); ASC payment indicator N1 (packaged). The bone graft substitute is paid inside the primary fusion APC (e.g., 22551 APC 5115 $13,117; 22630/22558 APC 5117 $27,722 in CY2026).

reimbursement.description: Allograft, structural, for spine surgery only (add-on)
reimbursement.payment_note: Same family as 20930: bundled on MPFS, packaged (N / N1) in HOPD and ASC. Listed in UHC 2026T0410KK and Cigna 0118 code tables.

reimbursement.description: Autograft for spine surgery only: local (20936), morselized through separate incision (20937), structural bicortical/tricortical (20938) (add-ons)
reimbursement.payment_note: Bundled (status B) on the MPFS and packaged in HOPD/ASC since CMS's 2018 bundling of spine graft add-ons; no separate payment.
reimbursement.challenge: Status-B assignment for 20936-20938 was not re-verified against the CY2026 MPFS file in this sweep.

reimbursement.description: Bone marrow aspiration for bone grafting, spine surgery only, through separate skin or fascial incision (add-on, created 2018)
reimbursement.payment_note: Listed as a covered autograft technique by UHC (BMA used for bone grafting is 'proven'); MPFS payment status not verified here.

reimbursement.description: Bone marrow harvesting for transplantation; allogeneic (38230) / autologous (38232)
reimbursement.payment_note: Transplant harvest codes; Cigna 0118 lists 38232 and 38241 among codes that are experimental/unproven when used to report BMAC for bone healing. For spine grafting the correct code is 20939, not 38232.

reimbursement.description: Injection(s), platelet rich plasma, any site, including image guidance, harvesting and preparation when performed (Category III)
reimbursement.payment_note: Carrier/contractor priced on the MPFS (work RVU 0); packaged under OPPS; Medicare MACs treat MSK PRP as not reasonable and necessary (NCD 270.3 covers only chronic diabetic wounds). Commercial payers (Aetna, BCBSM) call PRP experimental.

reimbursement.description: Intramuscular autologous bone marrow cell therapy, with/without preparation and harvest (Category III)
reimbursement.payment_note: Carrier priced; coverage 'extremely limited' and generally denied for MSK/pain indications.

reimbursement.description: Harvesting and processing of autologous BMAC with application onto scaffold or injection into recipient site, excluding spine (Category III); 0565T/0566T autologous adipose-derived regenerative cell therapy
reimbursement.payment_note: Cigna 0118 lists 1095T as experimental/unproven for bone healing; Category III codes carry no RVUs and are contractor priced. 0565T/0566T were not located in any payer policy in this sweep.

reimbursement.description: Orthopedic/device/drug matrix for opposing bone-to-bone or soft tissue-to-bone (implantable) - created for Stryker Augment Bone Graft/Augment Injectable
reimbursement.payment_note: Transitional pass-through status effective Jan 1 2020 for 2-3 years (expired no later than Dec 31 2022); device offset applied; billed only with listed arthrodesis CPTs. Code persists in payer tables (Cigna 0118) as a descriptor but no longer pays separately. This is the clearest precedent for orthobiologic pass-through.

reimbursement.description: Orthopedic/device/drug matrix/absorbable bone void filler, antimicrobial-eluting (implantable) (CERAMENT G category)
reimbursement.payment_note: Active OPPS device pass-through category in CY2026: CMS updated the CPT codes billable with C1602 effective Jan 1 2026 as procedures left the inpatient-only list; it is not among the categories expiring Dec 31 2025 (C1826, C1827, C1747). This is the only orthobiologic device category with live pass-through status found for CY2026.
reimbursement.challenge: Start date of C1602 pass-through (and therefore its expiry, no later than 3 years after) not verified; check the CMS pass-through device category list (Table 6 / Addendum B).

reimbursement.description: Porous purified collagen matrix bone void filler (Integra Mozaik Osteoconductive Scaffold Putty / Integra OS; Mozaik Strip), per 0.5 cc
reimbursement.payment_note: Legacy C-codes effective Oct 1 2008 and Jul 1 2009; their pass-through period ended long ago and the products now sit with Orthofix (via SeaSpine). Payer tables (Cigna) still list them with 'may not be separately reimbursed'. These are NOT Infuse codes; no Infuse-specific C-code was found.

reimbursement.description: New device pass-through categories approved for CY2026
reimbursement.payment_note: None of the new CY2026 pass-through categories is a bone graft substitute or orthobiologic (C1741 absorbable metallic anchor/screw was a descriptor update). Pass-through lasts 2-3 years, then packages into the APC.

reimbursement.description: CY2026 OPPS removes 285 procedures (mostly musculoskeletal) from the inpatient-only list in year 1 of a 3-year phase-out; spine fusion APCs: 22551 -> APC 5115 ($13,117), 22630/22558 -> APC 5117 ($27,722); ASC 22551 J8 $9,031, 22630 $20,859, 22558 $20,101
reimbursement.payment_note: More fusion cases migrate to HOPD/ASC where the biologic is fully packaged and the facility eats the graft cost against a single APC/ASC rate. Device-intensive status applies to the cage, not the biologic.

reimbursement.description: CY2026 skin substitute overhaul: products unpackaged from application CPTs 15271-15278 and paid per cm2 by FDA category (PMA / 510(k) / 361 HCT/P) under OPPS, and as incident-to supplies under the PFS
reimbursement.payment_note: Single CY2026 rate $127.14 per cm2 for APCs 6000-6002 (CMS MM14361; PFS summaries cite ~$127.28 from the final rule display). Replaced ASP-based payment after spending rose from $252M (2019) to >$10B (2024). CMS intends to differentiate rates by FDA category in later years; CMMI prior-auth model adds skin substitutes in 2026. Context for 361 orthobiologics: the same 361-vs-510(k)-vs-PMA framing is now written into payment policy.

reimbursement.description: Blood-derived products for chronic non-healing wounds (autologous PRP)
reimbursement.payment_note: Effective Apr 13 2021: covers autologous PRP for chronic non-healing diabetic wounds for 20 weeks when prepared by a device FDA-cleared for exuding cutaneous wounds; PDGF products, becaplermin, and PRP for acute surgical/dehiscent wounds are non-covered; other chronic wounds and >20 weeks left to MAC discretion. No national coverage for orthopedic PRP.

reimbursement.description: Amniotic and placental-derived product injections and/or applications for musculoskeletal indications, non-wound (Noridian JE/JF)
reimbursement.payment_note: NON-coverage LCD, original effective Nov 12 2023, revised Oct 23 2025 (JE/JF consolidated); evidence insufficient for MSK injections/applications; similar non-coverage LCDs exist in other jurisdictions (CGS J15 draft discussed Jul 2023).

covered: rhBMP-2 (Infuse) for lumbar fusion in skeletally mature members meeting CPB 0743 criteria via ALIF/lateral approach or 1-2 level TLIF
rhBMP-2 for acute open tibial shaft fracture with IM nail within 14 days
Cadaveric allograft and DBM for spinal fusion and osteochondral/void fill
beta-TCP based extenders/substitutes for spine fusion
BMAC only for unicameral bone cysts

i-Factor peptide enhanced bone graft
Bioglass 45S5 and non-TCP ceramics; chronOS outside spine fusion
VIA Disc NP nucleus pulposus allograft (dental CPB cross-ref, Mar 20 2025)

payer_policies.title: Bone Graft Substitutes
covered: Allograft-based incl. DBM
Ceramic or polymer synthetic substitutes
Inorganic bone material (bovine, coral) alone or with a covered substitute
rhBMP-2 (Infuse) only for acute open tibial shaft fracture with IM nail within 14 days
Spine bone graft decisions routed to EviCore spine guidelines; stem cells to policy 0552; PRP to policy 0507
not_covered_or_experimental: rhBMP-2 for ALL other indications incl. sinus/alveolar ridge
rhBMP-7 (OP-1) all indications
Human amniotic membrane/amniotic fluid stem cell substitutes
Cell-based substitutes (MSC alone, on scaffolds, or allograft processed to retain cells)
Human growth factor substitutes (FGF, IGF)
BMAC alone, on scaffold, injected, or mixed with allograft (codes 38232, 38241, 1095T)
Substitutes used to reduce donor-site morbidity

payer_policies.title: Spinal Fusion and Bone Healing Enhancement Products
covered: Autografts incl. bone marrow aspirate used for grafting
DBM without unproven additives
Allograft-based products not listed as unproven
Infuse for single-level L2-S1 lumbar fusion, anterior or oblique approach with FDA-approved interbody device, skeletally mature, DDD, spondylolisthesis <= grade 1
Infuse/Mastergraft posterolateral revision device for symptomatic posterolateral lumbar pseudoarthrosis when autograft not feasible
not_covered_or_experimental: Cell-based allografts (MSC)
Human amniotic tissue materials
rhBMP-2 for all other indications (incl. cervical, TLIF, multilevel)
Ceramic-based products (b-TCP, calcium phosphate, calcium sulfate) alone or combined, incl. with BMA
Bioactive glass alone or combined
Expandable interbody fusion systems
payer_policies.challenge: UHC's exclusion of ceramics and bioactive glass is the most restrictive big-payer stance on synthetics (MagnetOs, Vitoss, Signafuse, Kinex, NovaBone all fall here); surgeons bill 20930 anyway because the biologic is packaged, so the policy bites mainly on prior auth and audits.

payer_policies.title: Bone Morphogenetic Protein
covered: rhBMP-2 (Infuse) in skeletally mature individuals for ALIF when autograft not feasible
Instrumented posterolateral intertransverse fusion when autograft not feasible
Acute open tibial shaft fracture when autograft not feasible
not_covered_or_experimental: rhBMP-2 for all other indications incl. spinal fusion when autograft is feasible and craniomaxillofacial surgery
rhBMP-7 (OP-1) not available in US

payer_policies.payer: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Oklahoma (HCSC)
payer_policies.title: Orthopedic Applications of Stem Cell Therapy (Including Allografts and Bone Substitutes Used with Autologous Bone Marrow)
covered: Unprocessed allograft bone and products not requiring mixing with stem cells are outside the policy (not addressed)
not_covered_or_experimental: Mesenchymal stem cell therapy for all orthopedic applications
Allograft bone containing viable stem cells (AlloStem, Osteocel Plus, Trinity Evolution, Trinity Elite named) - experimental for all orthopedic uses
Allograft or synthetic substitutes that must be combined with autologous blood or bone marrow (FusionFlex, Ignite named)

payer_policies.title: Bone Morphogenetic Protein
covered: rhBMP-2 for ALIF, instrumented posterolateral fusion, and acute open tibial shaft fracture, each only when autograft is not feasible (prior ICBG harvest or insufficient volume, e.g., multilevel)
not_covered_or_experimental: rhBMP-2 for all other indications incl. fusion when autograft feasible and craniomaxillofacial surgery
Notes 2013 IPD meta-analyses found little/no benefit over ICBG and uncertain harm incl. cancer signal

payer_policies.payer: Anthem / Elevance Health (Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, Ohio)
payer_policies.policy_number: CG-SURG-45 (enterprise clinical UM guideline, title 'Bone Graft Substitutes'; not adopted/listed in Ohio commercial)
payer_policies.title: Bone Graft Substitutes (CG-SURG-45); no separate BMP policy found
payer_policies.date: Ohio commercial adopted-guideline list update 10/1/2026 (CG-SURG-45 absent); TRANS.00035 cross-reference publish 10/01/2026, last review 05/14/2026
payer_policies.notes: Ohio library search 2026-10-22 found no bone graft substitute, BMP, or cellular bone matrix policy; bone graft products with exogenous MSCs fall under TRANS.00035 (investigational), endogenous-MSC bone grafts are cross-referenced to CG-SURG-45. The Ohio commercial adopted list (pw_ad083614.pdf) contains 63 CG guidelines and no CG-SURG-45, so a standalone graft-substitute criteria set does not appear to be applied to Ohio commercial members.
payer_policies.challenge: Anthem Ohio's provider policy library (state-gated; Ohio selected 2026-10-22) returns no bone graft substitute or BMP document: searches for 'bone graft', 'bone graft substitute', 'morphogenetic' and 'CG-SURG-45' return only wound/soft-tissue grafting (SURG.00011, CG-SURG-127), fat grafting and stem-cell policies, and 'spinal fusion' returns hardware/discography policies. The enterprise guideline CG-SURG-45 'Bone Graft Substitutes' exists by title in Anthem Medicaid adopted-guideline lists (NV 2017; CA/NV/IN Aug 2024) and is cross-referenced by TRANS.00035 for bone graft products with endogenous MSCs, but it is absent from the Ohio commercial adopted list (update 10/1/2026, 63 guidelines, no CG-SURG-45) and its document URL was not located. Treat Anthem commercial as having no standalone bone-graft/BMP coverage criteria in Ohio (MCG and spinal-fusion criteria apply) until the CG-SURG-45 text is pulled.

Becaplermin
PRP for acute surgical wounds/dehiscence
No NCD for orthopedic PRP, BMAC or amniotic injections (MAC LCDs govern)
